How clients describe a visit

Taken from what clients write in their Google reviews.

Walk in

Clients mention being fitted in straight away without an appointment.

Open on Saturdays

Saturday until 7 in the evening, as listed on Google, which clients find convenient.

Clean and bright

A very clean place, as clients write, with white marble floors and round mirrors.

In Basilica Gardens

Gossip Hair and Beauty Studio is at Lidas Street 5, Basilica Gardens, in Paphos. Inside: white marble floors, round lit mirrors and pale walls. The studio speaks English, Russian and Greek and takes bookings online or on WhatsApp, as it says on Instagram. On its card: come for the glam, stay for the gossip.
